options.content:
Costs & Limits

Estimated inference spend and limit enforcement. Cost filters do not apply to limit panels.

panels.title: Metered estimate in selected period
panels.description: Estimated metered inference cost accrued during the selected period at configured model prices. This is not an invoice and excludes subscription-covered equivalents. This comparison keeps its named billing mode regardless of the Billing mode filter.

panels.title: Subscription-covered equivalent
panels.description: List-price equivalent; not an additional token bill. This comparison keeps its named billing mode regardless of the Billing mode filter.

panels.title: Gross cache-read savings
panels.description: Estimated savings from prompt-cache reads during the selected period. Gross savings do not subtract cache-write surcharges. Billing and authentication filters do not apply to cache metrics.

panels.title: Estimated spend / hour
panels.description: Rolling estimated USD per hour, not spend already incurred in this hour.

panels.title: Estimated spend by model
panels.description: Estimated inference cost during the selected period, grouped by model. Uses configured prices rather than provider invoices.

panels.title: Estimated spend by agent
panels.description: Configured agents with the largest estimated inference cost during the selected period. The top ten are shown after applying cost filters.

panels.title: Cache tokens in selected period
panels.description: Prompt-cache tokens read and written during the selected period. These tokens are tracked separately from uncached input and output tokens. Billing and authentication filters do not apply to cache metrics.

panels.title: Estimated spend by selected dimension
panels.description: Estimated list-price inference cost in the selected period, grouped by Cost breakdown after applying the cost filters. Subscription usage is a price equivalent, not an extra token bill.

panels.title: Rule evaluations / second
panels.description: Limit rule evaluations per second by enforcement behavior and outcome. One request may evaluate several rules, so this is not a request rate.

panels.title: Hard rule refusals / second
panels.description: Hard-limit evaluations that blocked admission per second, grouped by target type and allowance kind. Unknown spend can also cause a hard refusal.

panels.title: Soft exceeded evaluations / second
panels.description: Soft-limit checks that found an exhausted allowance per second. These observations do not block requests and are not unique threshold crossings.

panels.title: Limit storage failures / second
panels.description: Failures reading or recording limit usage per second by operation. Storage failures are separate from exhausted allowances.

panels.title: Last exceeded check time
panels.description: Newest observation per rule/target across replicas. Retained for 24 hours in each process; absent is not proof of budget headroom.

panels.title: Usage at last exceeded check: token_cost
panels.description: Recorded USD usage at the newest known exhausted spend check for each rule and target. Selects the same replica as that check's timestamp; this is historical, not current spend.

panels.title: Threshold at last exceeded check: token_cost
panels.description: Historical observation. Compare only matching rule, target and check time; replicas can hold different observations.

panels.title: Usage at last exceeded check: tokens
panels.description: Recorded token usage at the newest known exhausted token check for each rule and target. Selects the same replica as that check's timestamp; this is historical, not live headroom.

panels.title: Threshold at last exceeded check: tokens
panels.description: Historical observation. Compare only matching rule, target and check time; replicas can hold different observations.

panels.title: Usage at last exceeded check: requests
panels.description: Recorded request usage before admission at the newest known exhausted request check. The rejected request is excluded; this is a historical observation.

panels.title: Threshold at last exceeded check: requests
panels.description: Historical observation. Compare only matching rule, target and check time; replicas can hold different observations.
